citation: B/01.png: all six clip rows set the score bold at the same left edge (~100px) with the rank number muted at one size, and the duration in a mono face right-aligned to a single edge (~221px); the section labels CAPTIONS and EXTRAS share one uppercase letter-spaced treatment.
why: B runs a deliberate scale (20/16/14/13/12/11) with eyebrow labels, a count pill and tabular numerals, so scores and times read as one system instead of ad hoc pulls. A is tidy but thin: a display heading over a 12px subhead, with almost no intermediate steps and only sidebar metadata as numbers.
